projects.title: Eventura
projects.subtitle: Event Booking & Management Platform
projects.summary: A full-stack event booking platform designed to connect clients with events, packages, services and vendors while providing an administrative management system.
projects.overview: Eventura is a comprehensive event booking and management ecosystem engineered to bridge the gap between event organizers, clients, and service vendors. It offers seamless discovery of curated events, multi-tier package selection, customizable add-on services, an automated booking lifecycle, and a feature-rich admin dashboard for operational control.
projects.problem: Event booking and vendor coordination are often fragmented across multiple communication channels, leading to double-bookings, unclear service package pricing, lack of transparency in scheduling, and manual overhead for event administrators.
projects.solution: Eventura consolidates the entire lifecycle into a unified digital platform. Clients can explore categorized events, inspect rich media details, select tiered packages or build custom bundles with add-on services, and track bookings. Administrators gain full visibility through a dedicated dashboard to manage events, client requests, vendor allocations, and payment verification.

keyFeatures.desc: Pre-configured event packages with flexibility to attach custom add-on services.

keyFeatures.desc: Multi-step booking wizard with input validation, date availability, and price calculation.

keyFeatures.title: Payment Verification Flow
keyFeatures.desc: Order tracking and payment status verification with automated client receipts.

keyFeatures.title: Administrative Dashboard

keyFeatures.title: Responsive & Animated UI
keyFeatures.desc: Crafted with React, Bootstrap, and Framer Motion for buttery-smooth cross-device experience.

challenges.solution: Designed MongoDB collections for Categories, Events, Packages, and Add-on Services with Mongoose references and population pipelines, ensuring data consistency without over-fetching.
Built a centralized state machine on the frontend combined with atomic server-side price re-verification to prevent tampering.
Implemented JWT authentication with HTTP-only tokens and custom Express authorization middleware distinguishing Admin, Vendor, and Client permissions.
Balanced rich motion transitions with lightweight CSS performance to ensure zero layout shift across mobile and desktop viewports.

projects.title: Empty Freight Optimization System
projects.subtitle: Logistics Management & Load Matching Platform
projects.summary: Logistics management application facilitating freight matching, transporter coordination, route availability, and business workflows to eliminate empty return trips.
projects.overview: Empty Freight Optimization System is a specialized logistics platform developed to address the empty haul problem in cargo transportation. It connects load providers with available freight carriers on return routes, maximizing vehicle utilization and cutting operational fuel waste.
projects.problem: Trucks and cargo vehicles frequently return empty after delivering freight, wasting fuel, driver time, and potential revenue. Finding verified shippers on return corridors required manual phone calls and middlemen.
projects.solution: Built a centralized digital exchange where transporters register truck capacities and return routes, while shippers post available cargo loads. The platform matches routes based on origin, destination, and vehicle capacity.

keyFeatures.title: Freight Load Listings
keyFeatures.desc: Post and discover available cargo by weight, cargo type, and transit window.

keyFeatures.title: Transporter Route Availability
keyFeatures.desc: Carriers broadcast planned return routes to receive immediate load requests.

keyFeatures.title: Direct Inquiry & Booking
keyFeatures.desc: In-app negotiation and booking confirmation between shippers and vehicle operators.

keyFeatures.title: Role-Based Portals
keyFeatures.desc: Dedicated interfaces for shippers, drivers, and logistics coordinators.

challenges.solution: Engineered query filters matching pickup dates and transit corridors within geographic tolerances.
Optimized mobile layout for drivers on the road with high contrast touch buttons and quick status toggles.

walkthroughSteps.name: Load Posting
walkthroughSteps.desc: Shipper creates a freight request with dimensions and route coordinates.

walkthroughSteps.name: Route Matching
walkthroughSteps.desc: Platform presents available transporters traveling along that corridor.

walkthroughSteps.name: Deal Finalization
walkthroughSteps.desc: Transporter accepts the cargo load, locking the return route capacity.
